components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default neutral action. Press-scale is the core tactile micro-interaction.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:40px; padding:8px 16px; border:none; border-radius:6px; background:#3b82f6; color:#fff; font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:0.875rem; font-weight:500; cursor:pointer; transition:all 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#3473dd; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #f6f3ee,0 0 0 4px #3b82f6; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:scale(0.97); }

components.name: Income Button
components.description: Money-committing positive action only. Never general emphasis.

components.name: Glossy Icon Pebble
components.description: The brand's one tactile indulgence. A circular hue-tinted glossy well around a domain icon.
components.css: .ds-pebble { position:relative; height:32px; width:32px; border-radius:9999px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; overflow:hidden; background:radial-gradient(circle at 38% 32%, rgba(255,255,255,0.96) 0%, color-mix(in srgb,#06b6d4 20%,white) 100%); box-shadow:0 3px 10px #06b6d435,0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.07),inset 0 1.5px 2px rgba(255,255,255,0.9); border:1.5px solid color-mix(in srgb,#06b6d4 28%,transparent); } .ds-pebble-gloss { position:absolute; inset:0; border-radius:9999px; pointer-events:none; background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 35% 26%, rgba(255,255,255,0.60) 0%, transparent 62%); } .ds-pebble-icon { position:relative; z-index:10; height:14px; width:14px; color:#06b6d4; filter:drop-shadow(0 1px 1.5px #06b6d455); }

narrative.overview: FinTrack looks like a serious financial record that happens to be on your side. The substrate is warm paper, not a cold dashboard: a cream canvas, ink-dark figures, and a small number of crafted tactile highlights that reward attention without ever shouting. Encouragement here is earned and shown, never decorated on. The system holds depth and restraint in tension and resolves it with one rule: tactility is a single voice, spent deliberately on the things that carry meaning, and withheld everywhere else. It explicitly rejects childish gamification and the generic SaaS dashboard reflex.
keyCharacteristics: Warm-cream paper canvas (#f6f3ee), ink-dark figures — light default, dark navy considered alternate.
A mapped domain spectrum: each financial domain owns one learnable hue; color is wayfinding and signal, never decoration.
One tactile signature (the glossy icon pebble) against otherwise flat, restrained surfaces.
Honest progress made visible: every metric carries a real trend against the previous period.
Tabular-figure discipline: money always aligns and never reflows.

rules.name: The Color-Is-Meaning Rule
rules.body: Every color on screen must answer 'what does this signify?' — income, expense, a domain, a state. A hue used purely to look lively is forbidden.

rules.name: The Honest Signal Rule
rules.body: Green and red encode direction of truth, not sentiment. Never recolor a real loss green; never red-flash a neutral number for drama.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Every monetary value renders with tabular-nums (Geist Mono). Proportional digits on money are prohibited.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Color Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Emphasis comes from weight and scale, never from gradient text or coloring a heading for importance.

rules.name: The One Tactile Voice Rule
rules.body: Dimensional depth is spent in exactly one place: the glossy domain pebble. Cards, inputs, sheets stay flat at rest and lift only on interaction.

dos: Do keep Canvas Cream (#f6f3ee) as the default; treat dark navy as the considered alternate, not an afterthought.
Do render every monetary value in tabular Geist Mono so columns align and totals never jump.
Do make every color answer 'what does this signify?' — income, expense, domain, or state.
Do pair direction with a non-color cue (sign, up/down icon, or position) everywhere a gain/loss is shown.
Do spend dimensional depth only on the GlossyIcon pebble; keep cards and panels flat at rest.
Do show progress honestly — real trend vs. the previous period, even when the trend is bad.
donts: Don't add childish gamification: no cartoon mascots, no confetti sprayed on actions, no patronizing badges or trophies, no 'Great job!!!' tone.
Don't rely on red/green alone to convey income vs. expense — always add sign/icon/position.
Don't use the generic SaaS look: no big-number hero-metric template, no grid of identical icon cards, no gradient text.
Don't use side-stripe borders (border-left/right > 1px as a colored accent).
Don't nest a card inside a card, or wrap every element in a container.
Don't introduce a second 3D/tactile treatment to compete with the pebble.
Don't recolor a real loss to look positive, or flash neutral numbers red for drama.
